title: ChacharApp — Juan Pablo Castro
excerpt: Voice dictation for macOS, local and free: hold a key, speak, release... and the text shows up at your cursor, with Whisper running on your Mac's Neural Engine. Like Wispr Flow, but free and private.
content_html:
Voice dictation for Mac

Stop typing. Start talking.

Hold a key, speak naturally and your voice turns into text in any app. Everything happens on your Mac — nothing travels to the cloud.

Like Wispr Flow, but free and private.

macOS 14+ · Apple Silicon · Free

Mail — New message

To: team@company.com

Subject: Quarterly report

Your dictation shows up here, right at the cursor…

Hold Right ⌘ and watch the magic ↑

In action

Watch it dictate in 11 seconds.

Hold Right ⌘, speak naturally, release… and the text lands already punctuated, right where the cursor is. Nothing to open, and nothing leaves the Mac.

100% local

No cloud, no accounts

Neural Engine

Accelerated Whisper

Push-to-talk

In any app

Private by design

Your voice never leaves the Mac

One key

Hold Right ⌘. That's the whole interface.

No windows, no menus, no mouse. Put the cursor where you want to write, hold the key and talk. It works with the keyboard you already have.

Try it: press and hold the highlighted ⌘ — or your physical Right Command.

How it works

Three steps. Zero friction.

Nothing to open, no copy-paste. It works on top of the app you're already using.

01

⌘ Hold

Press and hold

Hold your key. ChacharApp starts listening instantly, with no window in the way.

02

Speak naturally

Dictate the way you'd talk to a person. No weird commands, no forced pauses.

03

✓ Text ready

Release and done

The text lands right where your cursor is, already punctuated, in any application.

Privacy + speed

Whisper runs on your Neural Engine. Nothing leaves your Mac.

We run the speech model locally on Apple Silicon, on the Neural Engine — whichever one you pick, always on your machine. No servers, no subscriptions, and no words of yours travelling anywhere. The app doesn't track you or analyse how you use it: zero telemetry and zero cloud dependency.

0

data sent

~1s

from a phrase to text

∞

minutes, no limit

  • No telemetry
  • No usage analytics
  • No account
  • No network in normal use

You say:

“Send the deck to cubernetes over slack before eod.”

ChacharApp writes:

Send the deck to Kubernetes over Slack before EOD.

Accuracy

It tunes to the way you speak.

Add your own vocabulary: names, acronyms, technical jargon and brands. With phonetic matching you say “cubernetes” and it writes “Kubernetes” — without ever typing the misspelling into a rule.

Phonetic glossaryProper nounsTechnical acronymsAuto punctuationMultilingual

Full control

Everything is configurable. Even the engine.

Pick your shortcut, your microphone and the speech model. Use the bundled one, download another variant or import your own (WhisperKit CoreML) — and it always runs locally, never in the cloud.

History + privacy

Every dictation, stored locally. Only you see it.

A searchable local history keeps the raw recognition next to the final text: you see what it heard and what it fixed. Nothing leaves the Mac, no account, no telemetry. My favourite: I dictated its own name and Whisper heard “Chacha Wrap”. What got inserted: “ChacharApp”.

历史+隐私

每个听写，都存储在本地。 只有你看到它。
